title: Letter Entitlements Under Each Mortgage Pre-Approval Level
content:
Letters issued under a Mortgage Pre-Approval follow entitlements fixed for each level, as follows.

| Level | Letters may be issued | Letter may name a specific property and offer price | Letter may state a price below the largest supported purchase price | Business days to produce a requested letter | Letters that may name the same property address | Every letter prints the pre-approval expiration date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Pre-Qualification | Yes | No | Yes | 1 | 0 | Yes |
| Larkspur Pre-Approval | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 | 3 | Yes |
| Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 | 3 | Yes |
| Larkspur Underwritten Pre-Approval | Yes | Yes | Yes | 0 | 3 | Yes |
| Larkspur Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval | Yes | Yes | Yes | 0 | 3 | Yes |
| Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval | Yes | Yes | Yes | 0 | 3 | Yes |

A production time of 0 business days means the letter is produced on the same business day.

## Column notes

- **Letters may be issued**: whether letters may be issued under the level.
- **Property-specific letters**: whether a letter may name a specific property and offer price.
- **Lower letter amount**: whether a letter may state a price below the largest purchase price the pre-approval supports.
- **Production time**: the business days to produce a requested letter.
- **Letters per property address**: the number of letters that may name the same property address.
- **Expiration printed**: whether every letter prints the pre-approval expiration date.

## Level-by-level reading

- **Larkspur Pre-Qualification**: letters are issued, but none may name a specific property, so the figure for letters naming the same address is 0. A requested letter is produced in 1 business day.
- **Larkspur Pre-Approval** and **Larkspur Verified Pre-Approval**: property-specific letters are available, up to 3 naming the same address, produced in 1 business day.
- **Larkspur Underwritten, Jumbo Underwritten and Lock & Shop Pre-Approvals**: property-specific letters are available, up to 3 naming the same address, produced on the same business day.
- At every level, letters may be issued, a letter may state a price below the largest supported purchase price, and every letter prints the pre-approval expiration date.
